retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast layout featuring a central glowing neon emblem with liquid-like reflections against a deep black void, topped by a clean sans-serif header.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, vertically-oriented glowing neon structure composed of concentric rings and stylized lettering, casting a distorted, wavy reflection downward into a dark abyss, framed by a horizontal rule and clean typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central glowing subject against a void-like black background
Horizontal header separated by a thin rule from the main image
Vertical symmetry between the primary neon object and its liquid reflection
Contrast between sharp geometric typography and organic light distortion
coreInvariants: Vibrant red-orange neon glow with white hot-spots
Thin horizontal dividing line separating header from body

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The glowing emblem is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white-hot center of the concentric neon rings.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, follow the horizontal line across, then drop to the central glowing orb and follow the reflection downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central figure to emphasize the luminosity.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red and orange for the neon structure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the header text and the hottest points of the neon glow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds/oranges with extreme value contrast between the black void and white highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, red, orange, and white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all text elements to maintain a clean, modern contrast to the complex central graphic.
graphicDevices: Wavy distortion filter on the lower half

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic and tight spacing.
Provides a similar geometric structure and high x-height.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central glowing neon emblem made of concentric red and orange rings on a solid black background. Apply a liquid ripple or wave distortion to the bottom half of the emblem to create a reflection effect. Include a thin white horizontal line near the top edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the title in a white, medium-weight geometric sans-serif font in the top left corner, positioned just above the horizontal line with very tight letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text white and tightly spaced?
Does the neon have a visible liquid-like reflection?
Is there a horizontal rule separating the text from the image?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos in the central neon structure
Ensure the text is not a direct copy of the original artist name

mustAchieve: Smooth color gradients within the neon

postGenerationChecks: Check for color banding in the glow
Verify the horizontal rule is perfectly straight
Ensure the reflection distortion looks fluid
Confirm text is legible against the black background
recipe.reuseFormula: Black Background + Concentric Neon Subject + Liquid Reflection + Top-Aligned Sans-Serif Header
